title: Pin the node:24-alpine base image by digest in deploy/aws/Dockerfile
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server (pinned commit aaa72a040db4c32f3d6488d5e28e2892a68e9ee0), replace line 2 `FROM node:24-alpine` with the fully qualified, digest-pinned reference `FROM docker.io/library/node:24-alpine@sha256:<index digest>`. Use the multi-arch index digest, which must include linux/arm64 because AgentCore runs only arm64 images (deploy/aws/README.md). Read it with `docker buildx imagetools inspect docker.io/library/node:24-alpine` on the day of the change. Keep the tag in the reference for readability and add a comment with the date the digest was resolved. Add a `package-ecosystem: docker` entry for directory /deploy/aws to .github/dependabot.yml so digest bumps come back as reviewed PRs. Merge through a normal PR with 1 approval (releaseProcess.approvalsRequired). The policy defines no deploymentWindows; do not push images while this initiative is still proposed.
acceptanceCriteria: `grep -nE '^FROM ' deploy/aws/Dockerfile` prints exactly one line of the form `FROM docker.io/library/node:24-alpine@sha256:<64 hex>`
`docker buildx imagetools inspect docker.io/library/node:24-alpine@sha256:<digest>` lists a linux/arm64 manifest
`.github/dependabot.yml` contains a docker ecosystem entry covering /deploy/aws
A probe-iac re-run no longer reports the unpinned base image at deploy/aws/Dockerfile

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-iac for mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server at the merge commit and confirm the IAC-DRIFT-01 result no longer cites line 2 of deploy/aws/Dockerfile. The finding fingerprint 99dd6cfe...be4d stays open until task 2 also lands.

rootCause.description: The AgentCore Dockerfile references the mutable node:24-alpine tag with no content digest, so the base layer changes silently whenever upstream retags.
